deliveries: order owner read.name: deliveries: order owner read
deliveries: order owner read.using: exists (select 1 from orders o where o.id = "deliveries"."order_id" and o.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

meal_logs_nutrition_nonneg.name: meal_logs_nutrition_nonneg
meal_logs_nutrition_nonneg.value: ("meal_logs"."kcal" is null or "meal_logs"."kcal" >= 0) and ("meal_logs"."protein_g" is null or "meal_logs"."protein_g" >= 0)

meal_searches_has_target.name: meal_searches_has_target
meal_searches_has_target.value: "meal_searches"."target_kcal" is not null or "meal_searches"."target_protein_g" is not null

order_events: order owner read.name: order_events: order owner read
order_events: order owner read.using: exists (select 1 from orders o where o.id = "order_events"."order_id" and o.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

order_items: order owner read.name: order_items: order owner read
order_items: order owner read.using: exists (select 1 from orders o where o.id = "order_items"."order_id" and o.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

orders_confirmed_has_provider_id.name: orders_confirmed_has_provider_id
orders_confirmed_has_provider_id.value: "orders"."status" not in ('confirmed', 'completed') or "orders"."provider_order_id" is not null

payments: order owner read.name: payments: order owner read
payments: order owner read.using: exists (select 1 from orders o where o.id = "payments"."order_id" and o.user_id = (select auth.uid()))

profiles_unit_prefs_valid.name: profiles_unit_prefs_valid
profiles_unit_prefs_valid.value:
"profiles"."unit_prefs"->>'energy' in ('kcal', 'kJ')
      and "profiles"."unit_prefs"->>'weight' in ('kg', 'lb')
      and "profiles"."unit_prefs"->>'height' in ('cm', 'in')
      and "profiles"."unit_prefs"->>'distance' in ('m', 'km', 'mi')
